connect_proxy_path.description: Full path to the connect-proxy executable. Usually /usr/bin/connect-proxy on Debian.

socks5_server.description: Default SOCKS5 server (host[:port]) when using -s or SOCKS5_SERVER env. Omit port for default (1080).

http_proxy_server.description: Default HTTP proxy server (host[:port]) when using -h or HTTP_PROXY env. Omit port for default (80).

socks_version.description: Default SOCKS protocol version: 4 or 5. Used when no -4 or -5 is specified.

resolve_method.description: Default hostname resolution method: 'local', 'remote', 'both', or an IP address for custom nameserver.

ssh_proxy_entries.description: List of ssh ProxyCommand configuration entries for ~/.ssh/config. Each entry corresponds to a Host block. Use [] for no entries (e.g., rely on env vars).
